sections.heading: Contact Us
sections.subheading: Reach out to KISWA — we're here for you.

sections.heading: We're Here for You
sections.body:
Whether you're a sex worker seeking support, an organization interested in partnership, a researcher, or an ally — we want to hear from you. KISWA is rooted in community, and every connection matters.

All communications are treated with the utmost confidentiality.

sections.success_message: Thank you for reaching out. We will get back to you as soon as possible.

sections.heading: Our Coverage Area
sections.body:
KISWA serves sex workers across five counties in the Nyanza Region:

  • Kisumu
  • Siaya
  • Homa Bay
  • Migori
  • Kisii
